elements.content: Wait, why am I learning to crack safes?

You'll thank me.
Probably around 3am.
Somewhere with cameras.
Why does this one open for... everything?
That lock doesn't care what you enter.
*(sweating)* It has to be one of these...
Some locks can't be picked. No number opens that one.
You'd have known if you'd simplified first instead of guessing all night.
Simplify before you touch a dial. Every equation lands in one of three piles.
If x survives, there's exactly one number that works.
The x's cancel and what's left is just true. Every number works.
The x's cancel too — but this time you're left with a lie. 3 is never 7.
Simplify. See what's left. That's your answer.

x + 9 = x + 2 
How many solutions?

options: No number makes both sides equal
Every number makes both sides equal
Every number makes both sides equal

elements.content: Simplify the equation and see what's left: Variable remains (like x = 3) → one solution A true statement (like 6 = 6) → infinitely many solutions A false statement (like 3 = 7) → no solution
